extDescription.message: Makes Google Drive feel like Windows 11 File Explorer: medium icons view, Win11-style context menu, and dark mode for Docs/Sheets/Slides.

optMediumIconsHint.message: Restyles Drive's grid view: compact tiles, names below icons.

optContextMenuHint.message: Shift + right-click shows Drive's own menu.

optDebug.message: Debug: log selector matches to the console

btnDiag.message: Copy diagnostics from current Drive tab

diagNoTab.message: Open a drive.google.com tab first (and reload it after installing).

footer.message: Changes apply immediately. No network requests, no account access.
